partnershipPlan: A seniors' advisory group and a neighbourhood association review the plain-language summary for the board.
socialListening: No social media listening; outreach call notes from last summer are summarised in anonymised form.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The heat warnings are for old people; I am only seventy-four.
items.implication: Report evidence on how older adults perceive risk.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The cooling centre is two buses away; nobody on our street goes.
items.implication: Include evidence on transport to cooling centres.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Our worst heat day last summer was not an alert day.
items.implication: Explain the evidence on lowering thresholds and its uncertainty.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: When it is an alert every other day, you stop listening.
items.implication: Report evidence on alert fatigue with more activation days.

summary: Four composite voices on risk perception, transport, days below the threshold and alert fatigue.
